entities.summary: Adalbert III of Bohemia, also called Vojtěch in his native Bohemia, was Archbishop of Salzburg between 1168 and 1177 and then again between 1183 and 1200. His reign is marked significantly by the struggle with Emperor Frederick I Barbarossa. He is listed as a Blessed of the Premonstratensians.
